title: Chart tooltip with a shared-step line runs 20.6 px past the bottom of its chart at 375 px: fitWhy trims only the idle explanation
claim: Hovering a shared heating/hot-water step in the expanded chart at 375x812 under a fine pointer shows a 201.9 px tooltip in a chart whose box ends 20.6 px above the tooltip's bottom, in 12 of 12 such renders (de, en, sv x light/dark x reduce/no-preference), while no tooltip_hover render spills (0 of 72).
mechanism: fitWhy(tt, chartHeight - 16) keeps the tooltip inside its chart only by removing `.tt-why` items; a shared-step tooltip carries `.tt-shared` and `.tt-reason` prose and no `.tt-why`, so fitWhy returns at `if (!why) return;` with the box still taller than the chart, and the box (z-index 5, chartwrap overflow visible) paints over what sits under the chart.

evidence.unit: shared_steps_hover renders (of 72) whose visible tooltip ends >0.5 px past its chartwrap (max 20.6 px)
evidence.machine: box B9, 4 vCPU, Chromium 158.0.8127.18 (playwright 1.65.0 lock, rev 1254), headless shell
evidence.contention_note: the seat's full M1 grid run ran beside it; a count of geometry, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:fitWhy (with tooltipHtml, from the chart pointer-move handler that calls fitWhy(tt, rect.height - 16))

perturbation.change: m1_tooltip.mjs PERTURB=1: in memory, fitWhy's `const why = tt.querySelector(".tt-why");` -> `... || tt.querySelector(".tt-reason");`

metric_definition: Renders where the visible .tooltip's box extends >0.5 px above or below its .chartwrap box after the hover step (getBoundingClientRect).
phenomenon_property: Whatever lines a chart tooltip carries, the box fits inside its chart's height: every prose block it may hold is trimmed or dropped before the box leaves the chart.
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s1/m1_browser.mjs (RESULT popups; m1_summarize.py <renders.jsonl> --check popups lists every pop-up past its chart or the viewport)

null_control.note: tooltip_hover (a tooltip with a .tt-why block fitWhy can trim) spills in 0 of 72 renders in the same grid.

reproduction_steps: run the command above; read RESULT tip_spill_renders and the per vp/pointer line ({"375/fine":20.6})
proposed_fix_scope: fitWhy: after the idle explanation, shorten or drop the remaining prose blocks (.tt-reason, then .tt-shared's wording) until the box fits; value rows untouched.
